title: scaphyglottis brachyphylla
intro: Scaphyglottis brachyphylla, commonly known as the 'Fringed Scaphyglottis', is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Scaphyglottis brachyphylla include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
